reason: The mdbase-next migration needs provider-side freeze, retention and rollback of hosted collections. It sits in its own provider and HTTP modules because provider.rs and http.rs are at the 1,000-line cap; collection deletion moved with it. The drain status (H6) adds one public read and its response type, whose fields are the migration driver's drain contract. Review fixes add the rollback's restored-replica list to the status and the two lifecycle state variants. The distinct collection_migrating refusal is shared with replica registration through two crate-internal helpers, and replicas.rs reuses the files module's not-found error to stay within its line budget.
